description: This header file defines metrics, metric sets, contexts, and related utilities for a logging or metrics collection system within the ocudulog namespace. It includes enum definitions, template classes, macros for defining metrics and metric sets, and container classes for managing metrics.

classes.name: metrics_container
classes.description: A wrapper class to access metrics stored in a tuple, providing methods to read, write, and access metrics by type or index.

classes.name: metric_list
classes.description: A list structure for storing metrics of the same type, inheriting from a metric type T.

classes.name: metric
classes.description: Represents a basic metric with a value, name, units, and formatting kind.

classes.name: metric_set
classes.description: A collection of metrics and/or other metric sets sharing a logical relation.

classes.name: context
classes.description: Represents a grouping of metric sets and metrics, capturing the state of a program component.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes a value to a metric of type T.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads the value of a metric of type T.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Accesses a metric element of type T.

methods.name: at
methods.description: Accesses an element in a list metric by index.

methods.name: contents
methods.description: Returns the raw tuple of metrics stored in the container.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of a metric set or context.
